title: RAG Component Manifest
description: Canonical metadata for one copy-ready RAG component. This file is the single source of truth consumed by the ragkit CLI, the test suite, and the cookbook generator; no component definition is maintained anywhere else.

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier used by ragkit list/info/add.

source.description: Path to the component's primary module, relative to the component directory.

dependencies.description: IDs of other COMPONENTS this one needs copied first. Package names are never placed here; use required_packages/optional_packages for those.

destination.description: Target path inside the destination project. {project_package} is substituted at add time. Relative, forward-slash, and contained by construction: absolute paths, backslashes, and any `..` segment are rejected here so a manifest can never aim outside the resolved destination root.

status.description: Lifecycle status shown by ragkit list/info. ragkit add refuses v2-deferred components and names the deferral.

required_packages.description: Third-party distributions imported unconditionally by this component.

optional_packages.description: Third-party distributions imported lazily inside a guarded branch. Absence must raise an ImportError naming the distribution, the component id, and the install command.

external_services.description: Network services this component calls when configured. Empty for local-only components.

install.description: Human-readable install instructions printed by ragkit add. ragkit never runs these; it only prints them.

missing_dependency_message.description: Exact text the component raises when an optional package is absent. Must name the distribution, the component id, and the install command. Asserted verbatim by tests (FR-3).

tradeoffs.description: When to use this component and what it costs. Rendered by ragkit info and the cookbook.

name.description: Distribution name as published, e.g. rank-bm25 or PyMuPDF.
